gallery.title: File:Kangaroos against Gun Turret.JPG
gallery.description:
Dusk at the Australian War Memorial in Canberra. During dry times kangaroos make their way in from the surrounding bushland to feed on the well-watered green lawns of the Memorial. Here a couple pose before a 5-inch gun turret from now scrapped HMAS Brisbane, which saw service in Vietnam.

See also File:HMAS Brisbane AWM Nov 08.JPG for same view in November 2008 after addition of HMAS Brisbane's bridge.

gallery.title: File:Thespis Canberra.JPG
gallery.description:
Thespis (1965), bronze, by artist Robert Cook, for the opening of the Canberra Theatre; commissioned by the National Capital Development Commission, Canberra, Australian Capital Territory.
Relocated in 1998 to the link between the Canberra Theatre and the Playhouse, at the City Hill entrance.

Unfortunately, long-term construction at the rear of the complex makes an uncluttered image difficult to achieve.
